job_description:
Are you a Python enthusiast with a Computer Science degree? Join our backend team and help build scalable, high-performance systems that power our platform used by thousands of customers.

What You'll Build:
- Design and implement RESTful APIs using FastAPI/Django
- Develop microservices architecture
- Optimize database queries and system performance
- Build data processing pipelines
- Implement caching strategies with Redis
- Write comprehensive unit and integration tests
- Create technical documentation
- Monitor and troubleshoot production systems

What We Need:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
- 0-2 years of Python development experience
- Strong understanding of object-oriented programming
- Experience with web frameworks (FastAPI, Django, or Flask)
- Knowledge of SQL databases (PostgreSQL preferred)
- Familiarity with API design principles
- Understanding of data structures and algorithms
- Git and version control proficiency

Great to Have:
- Experience with async Python (asyncio, aiohttp)
- Knowledge of Docker and containerization
- Understanding of message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka)
- Experience with testing frameworks (pytest, unittest)
- Exposure to NoSQL databases (MongoDB, Redis)
- Cloud platform experience (AWS, GCP)
- Understanding of software design patterns

What We Offer:
- Starting salary: $85,000 - $120,000 based on experience
- Annual performance reviews and raises
- Full health, dental, and vision coverage
- 401k retirement plan with matching
- Flexible PTO policy
- Work from home options (SF Bay Area based)
- Latest development tools and equipment
- Continuous learning and growth opportunities
- Collaborative and supportive team environment
- Office in San Francisco with great amenities
